ops.entry: WHEN apply remediates a high plan-reader finding and the team runs no re-read step DO put it to the operator as one blocking signature question with a recommendation instead of re-spawning the reader — an overrule-as-applied costs no spawn, and the run's FAIL still records the unread gap.
ops.why: Plan run closed FAIL on an applied-but-unread high finding; the operator overruled it as applied at signature and validation later confirmed the remedy by execution, so no reader re-spawn was needed.
